sources.note: Holden says the reason the base Gen III - which is available with Berlina, Calais and S ute - torque figure is different between VX series II and VY is because it has moved from the DIN standard to a "more international standard" - ECE.

sources.title: Holden Ltd: VZ Monaro sales brochure (Copyright Holden Ltd November 2004, MONVZ1004), specifications (PDF with text layer on archive.org)
sources.note: 'Power (ECE, kW) 260 @ 5600rpm*' (as saved in the LS1 engine data).

reason.method: Extrapolated from Holden's stated switch to every Australian figure first published from 2002 on.
